manifest.description: 71 specialized skills for full-stack development: 12 language experts (Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, C++, Swift, Kotlin, C#, PHP, Java, SQL, JavaScript), 9 backend frameworks, 8 frontend/mobile, plus infrastructure, DevOps, security, and testing skills. Includes 13 project workflow commands for codebase intake, discovery, specs, ticket execution and common-ground.
manifest.name: fullstack-dev-skills

hooks.command: m="$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null)/ticket-guard/marker.json"; [ -f "$m" ] || exit 0; u="$(command -v uv)"; for c in "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" "$HOME/.cargo/bin/uv"; do [ -n "$u" ] || { [ -x "$c" ] && u="$c"; }; done; [ -n "$u" ] || { echo "ticket-guard: uv not found on the PATH Claude Code runs hooks with, or in ~/.local/bin or ~/.cargo/bin. A ticket is in progress, so the guard blocks this instead of letting it through unchecked. Put uv on that PATH and retry (see Goal Runs, 'When something goes wrong')." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$u" run -q --no-project --python ">=3.11" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/runtime/guard.pyz" hook post-tool-use
